source: That’s truly unfortunate, Mr. Nomoru… I was certain that you would accept this offer!
translation: 这真的很遗憾，Nomoru先生……我确信您会接受这个提议！

source: I hope you understand, Mr. Clermont, but I’m more than satisfied with the state of Camp Buddy.
translation: 希望您能理解，Clermont先生，但我对 Camp Buddy 的现状已经十分满意。

source: I also believe that continuing to work alongside Yoshinori will allow us to maintain the spirit and quality of the camp better than we otherwise could.
translation: 我也相信，继续与 Yoshinori 并肩工作，能让我们比其他方式更好地维持营地的精神与品质。

source: *sigh* Well, the deed is done…
translation: *叹气* 嗯，事情已经办完了……

source: I think you settled it in the best way possible, Goro. Now I’m glad it’ll finally be off your chest.
translation: 我想你以最好的方式解决了这件事，Goro。现在我很高兴它终于能从你心头卸下。

source: Yeah, but I have to admit, it felt surreal turning down something I spent my whole life working towards…
translation: 是啊，但我必须承认，拒绝一件我花费整个人生努力追求的事，感觉太不真实了……

source: And when I found out that you were returning, I couldn’t feel a thing…
translation: 而当我得知你要回来时，我毫无感觉……

source: Being reunited with you was something I was waiting for all along, yet I didn’t know where or how I’d begin to reconnect…
translation: 与你重逢是我一直期待的事，但我不知道该从哪里、如何开始重新建立联系……

source: Goro…
translation: Goro……

source: I wish I’d had the courage to ask you exactly what happened when we were apart.
translation: 我希望自己有勇气问清我们分开时究竟发生了什么。

source: When I came back to Camp Buddy, it was nothing like before…
translation: 当我回到 Camp Buddy 时，这里已经完全不像从前……

source: I didn’t know my way around, and I was so overwhelmed with how different it had become…
translation: 我不知道该如何适应，它变得如此不同让我不堪重负……

source: I was lost for guidance, yet I couldn’t bring myself to approach you, thinking that it would only burden you more…
translation: 我茫然无措，却无法让自己靠近你，因为我觉得那只会给你增加更多负担……

source: I knew how busy and stressed you were, so I tried my hardest on my own, hoping that I could make things good for you…
translation: 我知道你有多忙、多有压力，所以我独自尽全力，希望能让事情对你好一些……

source: But even then, I failed you at one point, putting us in a position that caused all the trouble we had to solve today.
translation: 但即使那样，我也曾在一个关键点辜负了你，让我们陷入造成今天所有麻烦的处境。

source: That wouldn’t have happened to begin with if I was there guiding you…
translation: 如果我当时在那里引导你，这件事从一开始就不会发生……

source: I’ve witnessed the camp change in ways I never wished for… from the scoutmasters losing their passion to the scouts becoming uninterested and unruly…
translation: 我目睹营地以我从不希望的方式改变……从童子军团长失去热情，到童子军变得没兴趣又不守规矩……

source: I only had myself to blame for being at the top of all of it… and it only made me more bitter at my own inaction.
translation: 我只能责怪自己处在这一切的顶端……这只让我对自己的无所作为更加苦涩。

source: In my head, I was counting on you, Yoshinori, to succeed… begging you to bring back the spirit that was lost…
translation: 我心里一直指望你成功，Yoshinori……恳求你带回失去的精神……

source: I refused to guide you and believed there was nothing I could do to help, considering how helpless I was myself…
translation: 我拒绝引导你，相信鉴于自己如此无助，没有什么能帮上忙……

source: It only made me shut off even more, and I felt like all our hardships were for nothing… It was a cycle of self-destruction…
translation: 这只让我更加封闭，我觉得我们所有艰辛都毫无意义……那是一种自我毁灭的循环……

source: But all of that is finally over…
translation: 但这一切终于结束了……

source: And I have you to thank for it.
translation: 而我要为此感谢你。

source: But it wasn’t me who made all of these changes possible…
translation: 但让所有这些改变成为可能的不是我……

source: It was you all along, Goro… I was only there to listen, and allow you to grow at your own pace…
translation: 一直都是你，Goro……我只是在那里倾听，让你以自己的步调成长……

source: …I’d say your best quality is the way you always persevere no matter the predicament you face, coming out stronger than you were before each time.
translation: ……我会说你最好的品质，是无论面对什么困境都坚持不懈，每次都比以前更强地走出来。

source: I’m glad you see that in me, Yoshinori…
translation: 我很高兴你能在我身上看到这一点，Yoshinori……

source: That’s what I love about you the most…!
translation: 那是我最爱你的地方……！

source: And what I love the most about you is your dedication.
translation: 而我最爱你的，是你的奉献。

source: Despite all the struggles we’ve had and the times that things got muddled between us… You always stayed…
translation: 尽管我们经历了所有困难，也有我们之间事情变得混乱的时刻……你总是留下来……

source: You were doing everything you could to help the camp… and to help me.
translation: 你尽一切所能帮助营地……也帮助我。

source: You’ve been patient and understanding even when I didn’t deserve it... And I admit there was a time when I took that for granted.
translation: 即使我不配，你也始终耐心且善解人意……我承认曾有一段时间把这视作理所当然。

source: Now, I can finally do things right, and treat you the way you deserve and more…
translation: 现在，我终于能正确行事，以你应得的方式甚至更好地对待你……

source: So, thanks for staying by my side and supporting my decision, Yoshinori.
translation: 所以，谢谢你留在我身边并支持我的决定，Yoshinori。

source: Of course, Goro… I’ll always be here for you.
translation: 当然，Goro……我会永远在这里陪你。

source: *ehem*, I think our conversation got way too sentimental.
translation: *咳哼*，我想我们的对话变得太感性了。

source: Ahehe… I-I don’t mind, really… In fact, I think it’s really sweet coming from you.
translation: 啊哈哈……我、我真的不介意……事实上，我觉得从你嘴里说出来很甜蜜。

source: Well, if you keep pointing it out like that, you’re going to make me want to do it less.
translation: 嗯，如果你一直这样指出来，只会让我更不想这么做。

source: Haha! Don’t be shy, you can act however you want whenever you’re around me, Goro!
translation: 哈哈！别害羞，Goro，只要和我在一起，你想怎样表现都可以！

source: Heh…
Yes… In fact, I just called him earlier to confirm it…
translation: 是的……事实上，我刚才给他打电话确认过……

source: All I’m saying is that I’m happy where all of us are now…
translation: 我想说的只是，我对我们所有人现在的处境很满意……

source: And I don’t think we need anything more than what we already have…
translation: 而且我不觉得我们需要比已经拥有的更多……

source: Instead, we should do our best to cherish it and make sure we don’t lose sight of what’s truly important…
translation: 相反，我们应该尽力珍惜它，确保不忽视真正重要的事……

source: I understand, Dad… I really do.
translation: 我明白，爸爸……我真的明白。

source: Honestly, I’d hate to risk seeing you at your worst again…   And we’ve come such a long way just to fix things and return to how it was when we started…
translation: 说实话，我不愿冒险再次看到你最糟糕的样子……而我们走了这么长的路，只是为了修复事情，回到最初的样子……

source: Ah well, about that…
translation: 啊，嗯，关于那个……

source: What the hell is going on with you both?!
translation: 你们两个到底在搞什么？！

source: Now, now… There’s a perfectly good explanation for that, Yuri…
translation: 好了，好了……这有个完全合理的解释，Yuri……

source: You have to explain it to everyone else! They wouldn’t stop asking me about that bike all morning!
translation: 你必须向其他人解释！整个早上他们不停问我那辆摩托车！

source: Ah… I figured that’d cause a commotion.
translation: 啊……我猜到那会引起骚动。

source: I think everyone’s at the mess hall having breakfast. Maybe we should take the chance to talk about it before work begins today.
translation: 我想大家都在食堂吃早餐。也许我们该抓住机会，在今天工作开始前谈谈。

source: Alright. Let’s go then.
translation: 好。那我们走吧。

source: I thought it would be best if we concentrated our efforts and made one perfect Camp Buddy.
translation: 我认为集中精力打造一个完美的 Camp Buddy 会是最好的。

source: But I still would like to apologize for not consulting all of you first…
translation: 但我仍想为没有先征询大家的意见而道歉……

source: Psssh, It’s fine Gramps! You’re the president, so we leave the hard choices up to you!
translation: 噗，没事的，Gramps！你是营地负责人，所以艰难选择交给你！

source: That may be so, but I value all of your opinions. Yoshinori and I are leading this place, but all of you are what make it happen.
translation: 或许如此，但我珍视你们所有人的意见。Yoshinori 和我在领导这个地方，但让它实现的是你们所有人。

source: Thank you again for all of your understanding, and also for bearing with me while I was gone.
translation: 再次感谢你们所有人的理解，也感谢我不在时你们的包容。

source: Oh yeah! That’s even more important than all this – what the heck were you doing?!
translation: 哦，对！那甚至比这一切更重要——你到底在做什么？！

source: And why is there a sweet bike parked by your office all of a sudden?!
translation: 还有，为什么你的办公室旁突然停着一辆帅气的摩托车？！

source: Oh yeaaaah, where did that come from?!
translation: 哦，对啊啊啊，它从哪儿来的？！

source: It looks dope.
translation: 它看起来很酷。

source: Ah… well, I’m sure you all remember that I mentioned months ago that I was in a biker’s club during my youth…
translation: 啊……嗯，我相信大家记得几个月前我提过，年轻时我加入过摩托车俱乐部……

source: I-It’s true, Emilia… Sir Goro was the gang leader too…
translation: 这、这是真的，Emilia……Goro先生 还是帮派首领……

source: Th-This is news to me!
translation: 这、这对我来说是新闻！

source: So, is that the same bike you rode back then? It looks pretty vintage!
translation: 所以，那是你当时骑的同一辆摩托车吗？看起来很复古！

source: Yes, it is. I had it restored and tuned up yesterday… which explains why I was gone.
translation: 是的。我昨天让它修复并调校……这就解释了我为什么不在。

source: Damn… All of a sudden, you’re the coolest guy in the camp, Gramps…
translation: 天啊……突然之间，你成了营地里最酷的人，Gramps……

source: Ooh, ooh! Can you give me a ride one day?!
translation: 哦哦！有一天你能带我兜风吗？！

source: Uhh… Sure. Only one at a time though.
translation: 呃……当然。不过一次只能带一个人。

source: I want to ride Sir Goro too…
translation: 我也想骑 Goro先生……

source: Hihihi~ Looks like everyone’s interested in your new bike, Dad~
translation: 嘻嘻嘻～看来大家都对你的新摩托车感兴趣，爸爸～

source: Haha, maybe he’ll have to lead a new bike club soon.
translation: 哈哈，也许他很快得领导一个新的摩托车俱乐部。

source: Wait a minute, Yoshinori!
translation: 等一下，Yoshinori！

source: Show me your hand!
translation: 把手给我看看！

source: Umm… Okay?
translation: 嗯……好？

source: NO WAY…! That’s a real diamond!! Embedded on a titanium band too!
translation: 不可能……！那是真钻石！！还镶嵌在钛金属戒圈上！

source: Y-You noticed?
translation: 你、你注意到了？

source: Duh! I can sense bougie jewelry from a mile away! Real diamonds have a distinct sparkle to them that really catches the eye!
translation: 当然！我在一英里外就能感知到奢华珠宝！真钻石有独特闪耀，真的很吸引眼球！

source: Looks good on you, though~ Since when did you become interested in—
translation: 不过戴在你手上很好看～你从什么时候开始对——

source: Wait a minute… YOU DIDN’T—
translation: 等一下……你们不会——

source: SIR GORO!!!
translation: GORO先生！！！

source: Cat’s out of the bag, I guess…
translation: 看来秘密曝光了……

source: Wh-What’s going on?
translation: 怎、怎么回事？

source: Yuri… S-Sir Goro’s wearing the same ring…
translation: Yuri……G、Goro先生戴着同样的戒指……

source: And?
translation: 然后呢？

source: HOLY CRAP! YOSHI AND GRAMPS ARE ENGAGED?!
translation: 天啊！YOSHI和GRAMPS订婚了？！

source: Ahehe… Surprise?
translation: 啊哈哈……惊喜？

source: Hehe… I did it, everyone. You can call him “Mr. Nomoru” too from now on.
translation: 嘿嘿……我做到了，大家。从今以后你们也可以叫他“Nomoru先生”。

source: H-Hey… We haven’t decided on that yet…
translation: 嘿、嘿……我们还没决定那件事……

source: What the heck, that’s awesome news! Congrats! I’m super happy for you two!
translation: 搞什么，这真是太棒的消息！恭喜！我超级为你们两个高兴！

source: Awwwww~ I’m so jelly, I wanna get married toooooo~
translation: 啊啊啊啊～我好羡慕，我也想结婚～～～

source: Soon TM.
translation: 很快™。

source: Wait, wait, wait, wait, WAIT! This has got to be a joke, right?!
translation: 等等，等等，等等，等等，等一下！这一定是玩笑，对吧？！

source: S-Since when have you two been together?!
translation: 你、你们两个从什么时候开始在一起的？！

source: Y-You didn’t know, Yuri…?
translation: 你、你不知道吗，Yuri……？

source: What do you mean ‘you didn’t know’?!
translation: 你说“你不知道”是什么意思？！

source: They started dating back at the hotel, Yuri! I thought that was obvious!
translation: 他们在酒店时就开始交往了，Yuri！我以为这很明显！

source: EXCUSE ME?!
translation: 你说什么？！

source: So, you’re telling me, this whole time we’ve all been hanging out, everyone knew, except for me?!
translation: 所以，你是说，我们这段时间一直在一起，除了我以外所有人都知道？！

source: Are you serious? They’ve been literally inseparable since we started the project, wasn’t that enough of a sign for you?
translation: 你是认真的吗？自从我们开始项目后，他们简直形影不离，对你来说这还不够明显吗？

source: You not knowing is more shocking news than the engagement, honestly.
translation: 说实话，你不知道这事比订婚更令人震惊。

source: I don’t get it! How did this slip by my radar?!
translation: 我不明白！这怎么会逃过我的眼睛？！

source: W-Well maybe because Goro is your Dad…?
translation: 嗯、嗯，也许因为 Goro 是你爸爸……？

source: Hold that thought, Yoshi… Does this mean you’re also gonna be… Yuri’s dad?
translation: 先别说，Yoshi……这是不是意味着你也要成为……Yuri 的爸爸？

source: WHAAAAAAAT?!!
translation: 什么啊啊啊啊？！！

source: Hahaha! Your reaction is priceless!!
translation: 哈哈哈！你的反应太无价了！！

source: Daddy Yoshi.
translation: 爸爸 Yoshi。

source: So, when’s the honeymoon, Gramps?!
translation: 所以，蜜月是什么时候，Gramps？！

source: THAT IS SO GROSS!! EW, EW, EW!!
translation: 太恶心了！！呃，呃，呃！！

source: Of all the ships to become real, why the two of you?!
translation: 所有配对里为什么偏偏是你们两个成真？！

source: Well, dear. You can save your objections for our wedding. Although, it won’t really change much, haha.
translation: 嗯，亲爱的。你可以把反对留到我们的婚礼上。虽然，那不会真的改变太多，哈哈。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOO!!
Hahaha, yeah. Just let her process it.
translation: 哈哈哈，是啊。让她消化一下吧。

source: {i}Everyone kept asking Goro and I questions as we ate our meal… We had to tell the whole story of how it happened for them to be satisfied.{/i}
translation: {i}我们吃饭时，大家不停问 Goro 和我问题……我们不得不讲述事情发生的完整经过，才让他们满意。{/i}

source: {i}Goro looked a little embarrassed, but happy too… He finally seems truly content to be taking this new step in his life.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro 看起来有些尴尬，但也很开心……他终于似乎真心满足于迈出人生这一步。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, we finished up and everyone headed to work on their separate departments.{/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们吃完了，大家前往各自部门工作。{/i}

source: Here’s the last of the dishes, Aiden.
translation: 这是最后一批餐具，Aiden。

source: Oh, hey there you two! Thanks for bringing them and helping clean up!
translation: 哦，嘿，你们两个！谢谢你们带来它们并帮忙清理！

source: No problem, Aiden!
translation: 没问题，Aiden！

source: *sigh* I see you’re already in your usual attire.
translation: *叹气* 我看你已经穿上平常的打扮。

source: Of course! I got a lot of work to do in here, so it’s gonna get hot!
translation: 当然！我在这里有很多工作要做，所以会很热！

source: Plus, I gotta keep the fanservice going if I wanna end up with a relationship like you two!
translation: 而且，如果我想拥有像你们两个一样的关系，就得继续提供粉丝服务！

source: I-I don’t think that’s how we got started, Aiden…
translation: 我、我不觉得我们是这样开始的，Aiden……

source: Haha, I know! But I seriously am happy for you two!
translation: 哈哈，我知道！但我真的为你们两个高兴！

source: Seeing how you’ve gotten so close over the last few months, all leading up to a proposal… wow!
translation: 看到你们过去几个月变得如此亲近，最后走向求婚……哇！

source: You must’ve really flipped a switch in Gramps, Yoshi, ’cause I can’t imagine him doing a romantic thing like that, haha!
translation: Yoshi，你一定真的让Gramps改变了，因为我无法想象他会做这样浪漫的事，哈哈！

source: *ehem* I’m plenty capable of romance, you know.
translation: *咳哼* 你知道，我很有浪漫的能力。

source: Obviously! Otherwise, there wouldn’t be a ring on Yoshi’s finger~
translation: 显然！不然 Yoshi 的手指上不会有戒指～

source: Now I wanna get fingered too!
translation: 现在我也想被“指”一下！

source: I-I think that means something else.
translation: 我、我想那是别的意思。

source: No chance, kiddo.
translation: 没门，小子。

source: That was a one-time deal, kiddo.
translation: 那是一次性的事，小子。

source: Aww… Maybe on a different route.
translation: 啊……也许换一条路线。

source: Now if you’ll excuse me, I gotta get lunch started ’cause I got hungry workers to feed!
translation: 现在请恕我失陪，我得开始准备午餐，因为有饥饿的工人要喂！

source: You two lovebirds have a good working day~
translation: 你们两个爱侣祝有个愉快工作日～

source: *sigh* He’s as insufferable as ever.
translation: *叹气* 他一如既往地让人受不了。

source: Haha, but I think he’s really happy for us!
translation: 哈哈，但我想他真的为我们高兴！

source: True, and Aiden has always been a big supporter of everyone here.
translation: 确实，而且 Aiden 一直是这里每个人的大力支持者。

source: But that’s enough chitchat. Come on, let’s get to work!
translation: 不过闲聊够了。来吧，我们去工作！

source: Alright, I suppose we should get started for the day as well, Yoshinori.
translation: 好吧，我想我们也该开始今天的工作了，Yoshinori。

source: A-Ah, wait you two!
translation: 啊、啊，等等你们两个！

source: Oh, Jin…! Did you need anything?
translation: 哦，Jin……！你需要什么吗？

source: A-Actually, yes! I was so caught up in you guys’ news that I didn’t remember, but I wanted to show you both something…
translation: 其、其实，是的！我太沉浸在你们的消息里，一时忘了，但我想给你们两个看些东西……

source: What is it?
translation: 是什么？

source: …I finished the blog project, sir!  Please check it out!
translation: ……我完成博客项目了，先生！  请看看！

source: I’m impressed. This looks like it took a lot of work.
translation: 我很佩服。这看起来花了很多工夫。

source: If you guys want to check it out more and explore each page, I’d be happy to give you a separate soft copy!
translation: 如果你们想更详细地看看、探索每一页，我很乐意给你们单独的电子版！

source: You really went the extra mile for this, Jin. I hope it didn’t affect your other work too much.
translation: 你为此真的付出了额外努力，Jin。希望它没有太影响你的其他工作。

source: That’s good. I do remember helping out a few times as well… It was enjoyable.
translation: 那很好。我确实记得也帮过几次忙……很愉快。

source: Aww, Jin…
translation: 啊，Jin……

source: That’s not an easy thing to do, either.
translation: 那也不是容易做到的事。

source: I understand, Jin. It’s already hard as a leader to watch people leave, especially when you’ve grown fond of them.
translation: 我理解，Jin。作为领导者，看着人们离开已经很难，尤其是当你已经喜欢上他们。

source: It’s just a thought, but have you considered joining our staff?
translation: 这只是个想法，但你考虑过加入我们的员工团队吗？

source: W-Whoa, are you offering Jin a job, sir?!
translation: 哇、哇，您是在给 Jin 一份工作吗，先生？！

source: I am. Jin here has done excellent work for us over the course of the project, and I’d hate to lose him.
translation: 是的。这里的 Jin 在整个项目中为我们做了出色工作，我不愿失去他。

source: Exactly, and there’s no one more suited for the job than the person who set it up.
translation: 正是如此，而且没有人比建立它的人更适合这份工作。

source: Well, I leave it up to you. But it would give me pleasure if you’d submit to me.
translation: 嗯，由你决定。但如果你愿意臣服于我，会令我愉悦。

source: A-Ah, I think he’s just saying that we’re willing to receive you, Jin!
translation: 啊、啊，我想他只是说我们愿意接纳你，Jin！

source: Guuuuuh… Maybe I should stay after all…
translation: 唔唔唔……也许我终究该留下……

source: Ahehe, I think he’s misunderstanding us, sir…
translation: 啊哈哈，我想他误会我们了，先生……

source: Heh, but that’s part of the fun.
translation: 呵，但那也是乐趣的一部分。

source: M-Maybe we should go before we give him another nosebleed.
translation: 也、也许我们该在让他再次流鼻血前离开。

source: Haha, alright. Just let me know in the future, Jin!
translation: 哈哈，好吧。以后告诉我就好，Jin！

source: Y-Yes sir…!
translation: 是、是的，先生……！

source: Oh, heya Yoshi and Sir Goro! What brings you here?
translation: 哦，嘿，Yoshi 和 Goro先生！你们为什么来这里？

source: Yoshinori was telling me we had a delivery yesterday – I just wanted to check it out.
translation: Yoshinori 告诉我昨天有一批送货——我只是想看看。

source: Sure thing, sir! I’ll show you!
translation: 当然，先生！我带您看！

source: I’m gonna get started on the other work.
translation: 我去开始其他工作。

source: Sure thing, babe. Love ya!
translation: 当然，宝贝。爱你！

source: EHEM, what do you sayyyyy?
translation: 咳哼，你该说什么啊啊啊啊？

source: L-Love you too…
translation: 我、我也爱你……

source: Mwahh!
translation: 么啊！

source: Thank youuuuu~
translation: 谢谢你～～～～

source: Y-You’re welcome…
translation: 不、不客气……

source: Wh-Whoa! I’ve never seen you two like that before, Lloyd!
translation: 哇、哇！我以前从没见过你们两个这样，Lloyd！

source: Looks like we weren’t the only couple around here, huh?
translation: 看来这里不只我们一对情侣，对吧？

source: Oh, it’s actually new! After we played that game the other day, Dar and I had a serious talk.
translation: 哦，这其实是新的！前几天我们玩完那个游戏后，Dar 和我认真谈了一次。

source: I was tired of us not having a label and being all secretive of our relationship around everyone.
translation: 我厌倦了我们没有关系定义，并在大家面前对关系遮遮掩掩。

source: I mean, come on! We’ve been together for 9 years now! What point is there in hiding?
translation: 我是说，拜托！我们已经在一起九年了！藏着有什么意义？

source: I know exactly what that’s like...
translation: 我完全知道那是什么感觉……

source: Well, it turns out that Dar felt the same way, and all we had to do was talk about it!
translation: 嗯，结果 Dar 也有同样感受，而我们要做的只是谈谈！

source: That’s really great to hear, Lloyd. I’m happy to see you two finally working things out together.
translation: 听到这个真好，Lloyd。我很高兴看到你们两个终于一起解决问题。

source: Well, I was actually inspired by you, sir!
translation: 嗯，其实我是受到您启发，先生！

source: Me? How so?
translation: 我？怎么说？

source: Ever since we came back here, I’ve seen how you’ve been getting closer to Yoshi, even including the proposal!
translation: 自从我们回到这里，我看到你如何与 Yoshi 越来越亲近，甚至包括求婚！

source: I really admire all the confidence and guts it took to do that, and I figured I needed to start having some of that myself!
translation: 我真的佩服做到那件事所需的自信与勇气，我觉得自己也该开始拥有一些！

source: I-I see… I didn’t realize I’d had such an impact on you, Lloyd.
translation: 我、我明白了……我没意识到自己对你有这么大影响，Lloyd。

source: Haha, what can I say? You’ve always been my role model after all!
translation: 哈哈，我能说什么？你毕竟一直是我的榜样！

source: Aww, I think you embarrassed him, Lloyd, hehe…
translation: 啊，我想你让他尴尬了，Lloyd，嘿嘿……

source: N-No, I was just thinking about it for a moment…!
translation: 不、不是，我只是在想一会儿……！

source: A-And in any case, I’m just happy to be of service.
translation: 而、而且无论如何，我只是很高兴能帮上忙。

source: Now, should we go and see about those materials?
translation: 现在，我们要去看看那些材料吗？

source: Oh, right! I almost forgot haha!
translation: 哦，对！我差点忘了，哈哈！

source: Come on, they’re over here!
translation: 来吧，它们在这边！

source: Oh…! Hey there, Dad!
translation: 哦……！嘿，爸爸！

source: Which one?
translation: 哪一个？

source: ARGHHH… Come ooon… Don’t do this to meee….
translation: 啊啊啊……拜托……别这样对我……

source: Hahaha.
translation: 哈哈哈。

source: What brings you here, Yuri?
translation: Yuri，你为什么来这里？

source: I just had to drop off a report from the workers! I’ll be heading out to work with Emilia soon.
translation: 我只是得送来工人的报告！我很快会出去和 Emilia 一起工作。

source: Buuuut since I’m here! I wanna talk to you both!
translation: 但——既然我在这里！我想和你们两个谈谈！

source: O-Oh, about what?
translation: 哦、哦，关于什么？

source: Eughhhhhh… It pains me to say it, but… I am actually really happy for you two.
translation: 呃啊啊啊啊……说这话让我痛苦，但是……我其实真的为你们两个高兴。

source: Th-That doesn’t sound very happy, dear…
translation: 那、那听起来不太高兴，亲爱的……

source: I mean it! It’s about time that you had someone who can take care of you properly, Dad.
translation: 我是认真的！爸爸，你早该有一个能好好照顾你的人。

source: And honestly, I can’t think of anyone better than Yoshi here.
translation: 而且说实话，我想不出比这里的 Yoshi 更好的人。

source: He’s been the obvious pick all this time, I guess I just didn’t see it for some reason.
translation: 他一直都是显而易见的人选，我想我只是出于某种原因没有看出来。

source: Th-Thank you, Yuri. I’m sorry that we didn’t tell you sooner, though.
translation: 谢、谢谢，Yuri。不过很抱歉我们没有更早告诉你。

source: Honestly, it’s not you guys’ fault. I should’ve noticed the signs…
translation: 说实话，这不是你们的错。我本该注意到那些迹象的……

source: And I’m usually so good at that! What’s wrong with me?!
translation: 而且我平时明明最擅长这个！我到底怎么了？！

source: Haha, I think this is just a bit of a different situation, dear.
translation: 哈哈，我觉得这只是情况稍微有些不同，亲爱的。

source: Maybe, but either way, I’m grateful for Yoshi. Now I don’t have to worry about you as much, Dad!
translation: 也许吧，不过无论如何，我都很感谢 Yoshi。现在我不用那么担心你了，爸爸！

source: I can finally fully focus on myself~ There’s so much BL I have to catch up on!
translation: 我终于可以完全专注于自己啦～还有好多 BL 等着我补呢！

source: *sigh* I’m not surprised that’s the first thought you had…
translation: *叹气* 我一点也不惊讶那会是你第一个想到的事……

source: Hmph, it actually wasn’t! I’ll have you know you two almost ruined that for me too!
translation: 哼，其实不是！你们两个差点也把这件事给我毁了，知道吗！

source: The thought of you two… *shivers*
translation: 一想到你们两个……*发抖*

source: I can’t even think about it!
translation: 我根本不敢想！

source: Yuri! What the hell are you doing?! I’ve been waiting for half an hour!
translation: Yuri！你到底在干什么？！我已经等了半个小时了！

source: Oh, thank god you’re here Emilia. I’m losing it with Dad and Yoshi…!
translation: 哦，谢天谢地你来了，Emilia。爸爸和 Yoshi 快把我逼疯了……！

source: Oh~? Don’t you mean with ‘Dad’ and ‘Dad’?
translation: 哦～？你是说和“爸爸”还有“爸爸”吗？

source: BLECH! WOULD EVERYONE STOP SAYING THAT?!
translation: 呕！大家能不能别再这么说了？！

source: It’s true though~ When are you gonna make her call you that, Yoshi?
translation: 不过确实如此嘛～你打算什么时候让她也这么叫你呀，Yoshi？

source: I-I, uh—
translation: 我、我，呃——

source: NEVER, THAT’S WHEN!
translation: 永远不会，就是这样！

source: H-Hey! Where do you think you’re going?!
translation: 喂、喂！你以为你要去哪儿？！

source: Ahehe… Yuri is really having a hard time with this, huh?
translation: 啊哈哈……Yuri 真的很难接受这件事呢？

source: Haha, I never thought I’d see the day that she wouldn’t enjoy shipping someone, as she calls it.
translation: 哈哈，我从没想过会看到她不享受嗑 CP 的那一天，就像她自己说的那样。

source: But I suppose as her father, it is different.
translation: 不过作为她的父亲，想必确实不一样。

source: Y-Yeah… I can’t even think of her as a daughter… It’s too strange.
translation: 是、是啊……我甚至没法把她当作女儿来想……太奇怪了。

source: It even feels weird with you saying it.
translation: 连你说出来都让我觉得奇怪。

source: Now come on, let’s finish up work so we can wrap up for today.
translation: 好了，来吧，把工作做完，今天就能收工了。

source: Ahhh… A nice hot shower after a long day of work really takes the edge off.
translation: 啊……忙碌了一整天后洗个舒服的热水澡，真能缓解疲劳。

source: Heh, don’t get too settled in, though. We still have to deliver our daily report to Mr. Clermont.
translation: 嘿，不过别太放松了。我们还得把每日报告交给 Clermont 先生。

source: Ah, yes of course.
translation: 啊，当然。

source: The next few months are looking quite full, aren’t they?
translation: 接下来的几个月看来会相当忙碌，不是吗？

source: Heh, it turned out you got more than you bargained for.
translation: 嘿，结果你遇到的事比预想的还多。

source: I agree. I’m glad we were finally able to put our pasts behind us.
translation: 我同意。我很高兴我们终于能够放下过去了。

source: Heh, you could almost say this was a ‘scoutmaster season’.
translation: 嘿，几乎可以说这是一个“童军团长的季节”。

source: Our problems and struggles have changed over the years, but now we get to overcome them together.
translation: 这些年来，我们面对的问题和挣扎都变了，但现在我们能一起克服它们。

source: I’m ready to share our experiences with the next generation of scouts!
translation: 我已经准备好和下一代童军分享我们的经历了！

source: Me too!  I can’t wait to teach the scouts again!
translation: 我也是！  我迫不及待想再次教导童军了！

source: Then let’s make sure they have the best version of Camp Buddy to come back to!
translation: 那就让我们确保他们回来时能看到最好的 Camp Buddy！

source: I continued to learn more management skills from Goro, and soon we were both so in sync that the meetings and paperwork gave us no trouble!
translation: 我继续向 Goro 学习更多管理技巧，很快我们就配合得天衣无缝，会议和文书工作都不在话下！

source: In our spare time, Goro would take me out on his motorcycle to different places. We made a habit of going on dates on the weekend.
translation: 闲暇时，Goro 会骑摩托车带我去不同的地方。我们养成了周末约会的习惯。

source: Goro was brighter and happier than I’d ever seen him before – we were both looking forward to the future, with the camp and with each other!
translation: Goro 比我以往见过的任何时候都更开朗、更快乐——我们都期待着营地的未来，也期待着彼此的未来！

source: This project has been a reminder of just how far we’ve all come as a team, and how much I owe each and every one of you.
translation: 这个项目提醒了我，作为团队，我们一路走了多远；也让我意识到我有多么感谢在场的每一位。

source: Whew… The ceremony was a success!
translation: 呼……仪式很成功！

source: Wait… Were you nervous the whole time, Goro?
translation: 等等……Goro，你刚才一直都很紧张吗？

source: Well, not exactly… I was just ecstatic about all of the things we accomplished when I delivered that speech.
translation: 嗯，不完全是……我发表那段致辞时，只是为我们完成的一切感到无比激动。

source: I guess it only now hit me that we’ve finally reached the finish line.
translation: 我想直到现在我才真正意识到，我们终于抵达终点了。

source: I can’t believe we really made it this far.
translation: 真不敢相信我们真的走到了这一步。

source: Hehe, I really like seeing your soft side.
translation: 嘿嘿，我真的很喜欢看到你温柔的一面。

source: *ehem* don’t call me soft.
translation: *清嗓* 别说我温柔。

source: Well, let me at least get you out of that suit and into something better for the party.
translation: 那至少让我帮你脱掉这身西装，换上更适合派对的衣服。

source: I’m sure you’ll be able to relax there.
translation: 我相信你在那儿就能放松下来。

source: You know what’d really help me relax?
translation: 你知道什么最能让我放松吗？

source: *gropes Yoshinori’s butt*
translation: *揉捏 Yoshinori 的屁股*

source: GAH! You startled me…!
translation: 啊！你吓到我了……！

source: Heh, I know you like it.
translation: 嘿，我知道你喜欢。

source: I-I do…
translation: 我、我是喜欢……

source: I could really use a reward for all that hard work~
translation: 我这么辛苦，确实该得到点奖励啦～

source: *gropes Yoshinori’s chest*
translation: *揉捏 Yoshinori 的胸口*

source: Hngh… Everybody’s waiting for us at the party… A-Are we doing a quickie?
translation: 嗯啊……大家都在派对上等我们呢……我、我们要来个速战速决吗？

source: Why don’t we take our time instead?
translation: 不如我们慢慢来？

source: Nngh…
translation: 嗯啊……

source: Mmmhh… It’s been a while, hasn’t it…?
translation: 嗯哼……有一阵子没这样了，不是吗……？

source: B-But we’ve been doing it every night and morning…
translation: 可、可是我们每天晚上和早上都在做……

source: Well, too bad… I just can’t get enough of you… *kisses Yoshinori’s neck*
translation: 那可没办法……我就是怎么都要不够你……*亲吻 Yoshinori 的脖子*

source: Ahh…
Hehe… All of a sudden you don’t care that anyone can just walk in and see us, huh?
translation: 嘿嘿……突然之间你就不在乎有人随时会走进来看见我们了，嗯？

source: I just want you right now…
translation: 我现在只想要你……

source: Well, how about you show me how much you really want it…?
translation: 那么，你要不要让我看看你到底有多想要……？

source: You gotta work hard if you want a reward too~
translation: 想得到奖励，你也得好好努力哦～

source: LOOOOOOOOOONG!!!!!!
Oh no! G-Goro, toss me my pants…!
translation: 糟了！G-Goro，把我的裤子扔给我……！

source: MY EYES!! MY EEEEYES!!
translation: 我的眼睛！！我的眼——睛！！

source: *sigh* Guess we had that coming.
translation: *叹气* 看来这是我们自找的。

source: HNGH! I can’t get up from the table…! G-Goro, cover Jin’s eyes!!
translation: 嗯啊！我没法从桌子上起来……！G-Goro，遮住 Jin 的眼睛！！

source: D-DO YOU NEED A WHEELCHAIR?! OR PERHAPS COLON SURGERY?!
translation: 需、需要轮椅吗？！或者做个结肠手术？！

source: I think it’s too late for that, Yoshinori…
translation: 我想那已经太晚了，Yoshinori……

source: Hey! What’s going on in here?! Yuri was screaming and running away from—
translation: 嘿！这里发生什么事了？！Yuri 尖叫着跑开——

source: Yoshi – the not-so-virgin sacrifice.
translation: Yoshi——不那么纯洁的祭品。

source: G-Get out, you guys…! Th-There’s nothing to see here!
translation: 你、你们出去……！这、这里没什么可看的！

source: *mouth foams*
translation: *口吐白沫*

source: Get a hold of yourself, Jin. Somebody help the poor boy.
translation: 振作点，Jin。谁来帮帮这个可怜的孩子。

source: I’ll take care of him! You guys go finish up and come over to the mess hall for the meal!
translation: 我来照顾他！你们收拾完就来食堂吃饭！

source: I think they’re way more than finished.
translation: 我觉得他们已经做得远不止结束了。

source: Hehe, and it looks like Yoshi’s full already~
translation: 嘿嘿，而且看来 Yoshi 已经吃饱了呢～

source: W-We’ll clean up right away and catch up, everyone..!
translation: 我、我们马上收拾好就过去，大家……！

source: Seeya at the party then~
translation: 派对上见啦～

source: Oh god… that was so embarrassing, Goro…
translation: 天啊……太丢脸了，Goro……

source: Why are you so unphased by this?!
translation: 你怎么能对这件事这么淡定？！

source: GAHAHAHA!
translation: 嘎哈哈哈！

source: Th-That’s not funny…!!
translation: 这、这不好笑……！！

source: I-It really is, Yoshinori! I’m sorry! Hahaha!
translation: 真、真的很好笑，Yoshinori！对不起！哈哈哈！

source: Fuck, my sides are hurting, hahaha!!
translation: 操，我笑得肚子都痛了，哈哈哈！！

source: J-Just help me up already…!
translation: 快、快扶我起来……！

source: Ahh, it’s so nice to be enjoying everyone’s company again!
translation: 啊，能再次和大家一起相处真好！

source: And a little bird told me that someone here got engaged last year~
translation: 而且有只小鸟告诉我，这里有人去年订婚了～

source: Ah, yes. That would be Yoshinori and I, sir.
translation: 啊，是的。那就是 Yoshinori 和我，先生。

source: Congratulations, you two! You make quite the wonderful couple!
translation: 恭喜你们两个！你们真是很般配的一对！

source: Th-Thank you, Mr. Clermont…
translation: 谢、谢谢您，Clermont 先生……

source: I must say, this wasn’t really a surprise to me. Your pair has always had a special closeness.
translation: 我必须说，这对我来说其实并不意外。你们俩一直有种特别的亲近。

source: Pfft… Well, they were definitely extra close earlier.
translation: 噗……嗯，他们刚才确实格外亲近。

source: *cough* *cough*
translation: *咳嗽* *咳嗽*

source: It is true, though. Yoshinori here is quite the perfect fit for you, Goro.
translation: 不过确实如此。这里的 Yoshinori 和你非常般配，Goro。

source: Let’s just say—
translation: 这么说吧——

source: —if it fits, Yoshi sits.
translation: ——合适的话，Yoshi 就坐上去。

source: Hnghhh…
translation: 嗯啊啊……

source: *gags*
translation: *干呕*

source: Can somebody tell me what’s going on?
translation: 有人能告诉我发生什么了吗？

source: Yuri’s sitting way over here on the verge of choking, and you’re all talking like there’s an inside joke.
translation: Yuri 坐在那边都快噎住了，而你们说话却像是在讲什么内部笑话。

source: Well, there definitely was some choking.
translation: 嗯，确实有人被噎住过。

source: Are you alright, dear?
translation: 你还好吗，亲爱的？

source: NO, I’M NOT ALRIGHT! I’M TRAUMATIZED!
translation: 不，我一点都不好！我有心理阴影了！

source: Haha! Somehow I enjoy this Yuri more.
translation: 哈哈！不知怎么的，我更喜欢现在这个 Yuri。

source: Could we please, PLEASE, change the topic?!
translation: 我们能不能拜托、拜托换个话题？！

source: Looks like someone woke up on the wrong side of the bed today, hahaha!
translation: 看来今天有人起床气很大啊，哈哈哈！

source: Yeah, lighten up, will you?! We literally finished the project; you should be celebrating!
translation: 对啊，放轻松点行吗？！我们确实完成了项目；你该好好庆祝！

source: It’s quite surreal that the project is really done, huh? Camp Buddy is two times bigger than it was.
translation: 项目真的完成了，感觉真不真实啊，对吧？Camp Buddy 比以前大了两倍。

source: Y-Yeah, I feel like I’m having withdrawals already – after so much work the last few months, I feel like I should be working still…
translation: 是、是啊，我已经感觉像有戒断反应了——过去几个月做了那么多工作，我觉得自己还该继续忙着……

source: And in these darkest moments, Goro’s best trait really shined – his fortitude. It was the reason why I could move forward too.
translation: 而在这些最黑暗的时刻，Goro 最出色的特质真正闪耀了出来——他的坚韧。那也是我能继续前进的原因。

source: Lift the banner higher! NO, HIGHER!
translation: 把横幅举高点！不，还要更高！

source: Th-This is as high as my arms can reach!!
translation: 这、这已经是我的手臂能举到的最高处了！！

source: Need a piggyback?
translation: 要我背你吗？

source: Come on, boys! There’s no time! The ceremony will be starting soon!!
translation: 快点，男孩们！没时间了！仪式马上就要开始了！！

source: Uh… Yuri-dear… Maybe you should relax a little…?
translation: 呃……亲爱的 Yuri……也许你该稍微放松一点……？

source: Oh, don’t worry, Dad! I’m just making sure everything’s perfect for you and Yoshi~
translation: 哦，别担心，爸爸！我只是确保一切都为你和 Yoshi 准备得完美无缺～

source: It’s your most special day, after all!
translation: 毕竟今天是你最特别的日子！

source: …Which will be ruined if SOMEONE doesn’t finish setting up those chairs!
translation: ……如果有个人不把那些椅子布置完，这一切就会被毁掉！

source: Huhuhu I’m moving as fast as I can…
translation: 呜呜呜，我已经尽可能快地在动了……

source: She’s a real domme.
translation: 她可真是个女王。

source: R-Right, well, thank you for getting everyone to help, Yuri. I know it’s been difficult setting this all up last minute.
translation: 好、好吧，总之，谢谢你让大家来帮忙，Yuri。我知道临时布置这一切很不容易。

source: Not at all, Dad! You know parties are my specialty after all~
translation: 一点也不难，爸爸！你知道派对毕竟是我的专长～

source: Just leave it to me and I’ll have it all handled!
translation: 交给我吧，我会把一切都安排好的！

source: Okay! That’s all the chairs set up! I think we’re—
translation: 好了！椅子都摆好了！我觉得我们——

source: Ah, ah, ah! I had three more bouquets of flowers back at the mess hall that you FORGOT!
translation: 啊、啊、啊！食堂那边还有三束你忘记拿的花！

source: Go get them and be back here in FIVE MINUTES!
translation: 去拿过来，五分钟内回到这里！

source: Yes, ma’am…
translation: 是，女士……

source: Fwahhh, I love weddings~
translation: 哇啊啊，我喜欢婚礼～

source: Hello, Sir Goro!
translation: 您好，Goro 团长！

source: Ah, scouts! I’m so glad to see you all here!
translation: 啊，童军们！我真高兴见到你们都来了！

source: Of course, sir! We wouldn’t miss something this important!
translation: 当然，先生！这么重要的事我们不会错过！

source: You and Ms. Yuri looks so good too – I’ve never seen you both so dressed up.
translation: 您和 Yuri 女士也很漂亮——我从没见过你们打扮得这么正式。

source: Aww, thank you sweetie~ You boys have been a big help today too!
translation: 啊，谢谢你，亲爱的～你们男孩今天也帮了大忙！

source: Oh? I didn’t realize they were assisting with the preparations.
translation: 哦？我没想到他们也在帮忙筹备。

source: Yup! I helped Lloyd and Darius make the arch!
translation: 是呀！我帮 Lloyd 和 Darius 做了拱门！

source: And obviously I helped Bro-Aiden with the cooking~
translation: 当然，我也帮 Aiden 大哥做饭了～

source: HEY! Tell ’em what I did!
translation: 嘿！告诉他们我做了什么！

source: We kept the dumbass busy by letting him blow up balloons.
translation: 我们让那个笨蛋吹气球，好让他有事可忙。

source: You said that was important!
translation: 你说那很重要的！

source: Y-You did great, Yoichi.
translation: 你、你做得很好，Yoichi。

source: I can’t believe that my scoutmasters are actually getting married… *sniff* It’s just so heartwarming…
translation: 我不敢相信我的童军团长们真的要结婚了……*抽鼻子* 太令人感动了……

source: Ugh, this is like the fifth time he’s cried today.
translation: 呃，这已经是他今天第五次哭了吧。

source: I-It’s alright, Natsumi…
translation: 没、没关系的，Natsumi……

source: I just wish we had known sooner! We could’ve at least worn something more formal…
translation: 我只希望我们能早点知道！至少可以穿得更正式一些……

source: Haha, no need to apologize, Natsumi. Having you all with us today is all Yoshinori and I could’ve wanted.
translation: 哈哈，不用道歉，Natsumi。今天有你们大家在，就是 Yoshinori 和我所希望的一切。

source: I hope you’ll stick around for the after party as well.
translation: 我希望你们也能留下来参加之后的派对。

source: Of course, sir! We wouldn’t miss it!
translation: 当然，先生！我们不会错过的！

source: Anyway, we should probably get our seats. Looks like everyone else is moving in too.
translation: 总之，我们大概该去坐下了。看来其他人也在入座。

source: This better not take too long or I’ll start snoring.
translation: 最好别太久，不然我就要打鼾了。

source: If you do, I’ll smack you!
translation: 你敢的话，我就拍你！

source: Congratulations again, Sir Goro!
translation: 再次恭喜您，Goro 团长！

source: Hihi, I’m so glad I called them to join today~
translation: 嘻嘻，我真高兴今天叫他们来参加～

source: Me too. If it weren’t for them, I’m not sure we’d be standing here today.
translation: 我也是。如果没有他们，我不确定今天我们是否能站在这里。

source: Oh, and speaking of reasons we’re here…
translation: 哦，说到我们能站在这里的原因……

source: Hello, Goro and Yuri! It’s a beautiful day for a wedding!
translation: 你好，Goro、Yuri！今天真是个举办婚礼的好日子！

source: Ah, Mr. Clermont! Thank you so much for coming, sir!
translation: 啊，Clermont 先生！非常感谢您能来，先生！

source: Why, I wouldn’t miss it for the world! I just wanted to swing over for a moment and give you a little wedding gift before the ceremony~
translation: 哎呀，我无论如何也不会错过！我只是想过来一趟，在仪式前送你一份小小的结婚礼物～

source: Th-This is…!
translation: 这、这是……！

source: An all-expense paid trip to one of my company’s resort islands! I thought you and Yoshinori deserved to have a wonderful honeymoon!
translation: 我公司旗下度假岛之一的全额付费旅行！我想你和 Yoshinori 值得拥有一段美好的蜜月！

source: Kyaaa! That’s so exciting for you and Yoshi, Dad!
translation: 呀啊！这对你和 Yoshi 来说太令人兴奋了，爸爸！

source: Th-Thank you so much, sir! We’ll gladly take you up on the offer!
translation: 非、非常感谢您，先生！我们很乐意接受您的好意！

source: Heh, Yoshinori is going to freak out when he finds out!
translation: 嘿，Yoshinori 知道后肯定会兴奋坏的！

source: Haha, I hope so! Thank you again for the invite, and I’ll look forward to another fun gathering with you all~
translation: 哈哈，我希望如此！再次感谢邀请，我会期待和你们大家再一次愉快的聚会～

source: Mr. Clermont continues to be quite generous, doesn’t he?
translation: Clermont 先生还是一如既往地慷慨，不是吗？

source: Hihi, I almost expect it at this point~
translation: 嘻嘻，到现在我都快习以为常啦～

source: L-Let’s not get carried away with that mindset, Yuri.
translation: 别、别抱着这种想法得寸进尺，Yuri。

source: Anyway, where’s our ringbearer and flower girl? I haven’t seen them yet!
translation: 总之，我们的送戒指男孩和花童女孩呢？我还没见到他们！

source: R-Right here!
translation: 就、就在这儿！

source: Finally! What took you two so long?!
translation: 终于来了！你们两个怎么花了这么久？！

source: S-Sorry, Yuri! I just wanted to be extra careful holding the rings… I was scared I’d drop them.
translation: 对、对不起，Yuri！我只是拿着戒指时想格外小心……我怕会把它们掉了。

source: And obviously, I had plenty of prep work to do before hand – looking this good takes time after all~
translation: 而且显然，我事先有很多准备工作要做——毕竟要打扮得这么好看需要时间～

source: Ugh, why am I not surprised to hear that? You could’ve made us late!
translation: 呃，为什么听到这个我一点都不意外？你差点让我们迟到！

source: So? We’re not exactly at the fanciest of venues here! A little delay won’t hurt anything!
translation: 所以呢？这里又不是什么最高档的场地！稍微耽搁一会儿没什么！

source: Ahhhh, this just gets me thinking about how differently I’D do my wedding~
translation: 啊啊啊，这让我忍不住想，我自己的婚礼会办得多不一样呀～

source: A fancy hotel on a private island… Or maybe on the top of a beautiful mountain?
translation: 在私人岛屿上的豪华酒店……或者在一座美丽山峰的顶端？

source: Oh! Or maybe—
translation: 哦！或者——

source: Shush, you! I’ll help you plan your wedding some other day!
translation: 嘘，闭嘴！改天我会帮你计划你的婚礼！

source: Now go get into your positions!
translation: 现在去各就各位！

source: Alright, that’s almost everyone!
translation: 好了，几乎所有人都到齐了！

source: Wait, NO! We’re still missing the most important guest!
translation: 等等，不对！我们还缺最重要的客人！

source: Where the heck is Yoshi and the best man?!
translation: Yoshi 和伴郎到底在哪儿？！

source: A-Ah, hello guys! We’re sorry we’re late!
translation: 啊、啊，大家好！对不起我们迟到了！

source: You look wonderful, Yoshinori.
translation: 你看起来很棒，Yoshinori。

source: Th-Thank you, Goro. You look extra handsome as well.
translation: 谢、谢谢，Goro。你看起来也格外英俊。

source: Awww, would you look at these lovebirds~ Can’t even wait for the altar!
translation: 啊啊，你们看看这对恩爱小鸟～连走到祭坛都等不及了！

source: Aiden! What the heck took you so long?! You were supposed to have Yoshi here an hour ago!
translation: Aiden！你到底怎么花了这么久？！你本该一小时前就把 Yoshi 带来的！

source: Aheheh, well you know I was cooking everything for the reception, and I was struggling to put my tie on! Good thing Yoshi came to help!
translation: 啊嘿嘿，你知道我在为宴会做所有的菜，而且我正费劲地系领带！幸好 Yoshi 来帮忙了！

source: You were supposed to help Yoshi dress up! Not the other way around!
translation: 你本来该帮 Yoshi 打扮！不是反过来！

source: I had actually been dressed for a half an hour already, and went looking for Aiden.
translation: 其实我已经穿戴整齐半小时了，然后去找 Aiden。

source: When I found him, he was in just his apron in the kitchen as usual, hehe.
translation: 我找到他时，他和往常一样只穿着围裙待在厨房里，嘿嘿。

source: Hey, if you’d have let me, I’d be at the ceremony in just that, too!
translation: 嘿，要是你允许，我也会只穿那样去参加仪式！

source: Ugh, well at least you’re here now!
translation: 呃，至少你们现在来了！

source: Haha, relax, Yuri! It’s these two’s big day, after all! We should congratulate them!
translation: 哈哈，放松点，Yuri！毕竟今天是他们两人的大日子！我们该祝贺他们！

source: We will! After the ceremony! Now come on, let’s get to the altar!
translation: 会的！仪式之后！现在快点，我们去祭坛那儿！

source: Wah, Yuri!
translation: 哇，Yuri！

source: Alright, Dad and Yoshi~ This is your big moment!
translation: 好了，爸爸和 Yoshi～这是你们的重要时刻！

source: Whew… It’s finally happening…
translation: 呼……终于要发生了……

source: Heh, feeling nervous, Yoshinori?
translation: 嘿，紧张吗，Yoshinori？

source: Y-Yeah, I am a bit… My heart is pounding!
translation: 是、是啊，有一点……我的心跳得很快！

source: You and I are together now, Yoshinori…
translation: 你和我现在在一起了，Yoshinori……

source: You’re right, Goro.
translation: 你说得对，Goro。

source: Let’s go?
translation: 我们走吧？

source: Together?
translation: 一起？

source: Always...
translation: 永远……

source: We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Goro Nomoru and Yoshinori Nagira.
translation: 今天我们聚集于此，庆祝 Goro Nomoru 与 Yoshinori Nagira 的结合。

source: They have both prepared their own vows, and I would like to give them this opportunity to share them with each other. Mr. Nagira?
translation: 他们都准备了自己的誓词，我想给他们这个机会，让彼此分享。Nagira 先生？

source: Goro… We’ve both come so far since we first met here so many years ago.
translation: Goro……从许多年前我们第一次在这里相遇至今，我们都走了很远。

source: We’ve been apart, struggled when we’re together, and learned more about each other than we ever thought possible.
translation: 我们曾经分开，也曾在一起时挣扎，还比想象中更了解彼此。

source: I never thought the day would come where I could stand here with you, like this.
translation: 我从未想过，会有一天我能像这样和你一起站在这里。

source: But I couldn’t be happier than I am right now.
translation: 但我从未像现在这样幸福过。

source: Mr. Nomoru?
translation: Nomoru 先生？

source: Yoshinori… Even when I was at my lowest, you’ve always stayed by my side, helping me to overcome all the many challenges we’ve faced together.
translation: Yoshinori……即使在我最失意的时候，你也始终陪在我身边，帮助我克服我们一起面对的重重挑战。

source: Meeting and getting to know you was the best thing that’s ever happened to me, and I can’t believe it took so long for me to realize it.
translation: 遇见并认识你，是发生在我身上最好的事，我不敢相信自己花了这么久才意识到。

source: Standing here now, I’m ready to spend the rest of my life with you.
translation: 现在站在这里，我已经准备好和你共度余生。

source: And now, Goro Nomoru, do you take Yoshinori Nagira to be your husband?
translation: 现在，Goro Nomoru，你愿意接受 Yoshinori Nagira 成为你的丈夫吗？

source: I do.
translation: 我愿意。

source: Yoshinori Nagira, do you take Goro Nomoru to be your husband?
translation: Yoshinori Nagira，你愿意接受 Goro Nomoru 成为你的丈夫吗？

source: I do!
translation: 我愿意！

source: I now declare you married! You may now kiss!
translation: 我现在宣布你们结为伴侣！现在可以亲吻了！

source: {i}After the ceremony, we all went back to the mess hall for the reception. Everyone had a great time, and I loved every minute of the start of my new life with Goro.{/i}
translation: {i}仪式结束后，我们都回到食堂参加宴会。大家都玩得很开心，而新生活与 Goro 一同开始的每一分钟，我都无比珍惜。{/i}

source: {i}I can’t wait to share the rest of my days with him!{/i}
translation: {i}我迫不及待想和他共度余生！{/i}

source: Summer is right around the corner, though. The scouts will be coming back soon.
translation: 不过夏天马上就要到了。童军们很快就会回来。

source: Ohhh… Are you gonna be our disciplinary committee?
translation: 哦哦哦……你要当我们的纪律委员吗？

source: Speaking of which… looks like some people really can’t wait for summer.
translation: 说到这个……看来有些人真的迫不及待等夏天到了。

source: EHEM, lucky for you two, I’m a professional, so I’ll let that slide!
translation: 咳咳，算你们两个走运，我是专业的，所以这次就算了！

source: Hey, ya’ll! Food’s ready! I made hotdogs and burgers!
translation: 嘿，大家！食物好了！我做了热狗和汉堡！

source: *gasp* Burgers!
translation: *倒吸气* 汉堡！

source: Alright! I’m done playing house with you, dorks!
translation: 好了！我不陪你们这些笨蛋玩过家家了！

source: And… There go my scouts.
translation: 然后……我的童军们就跑掉了。

source: Haha! Looks like y’all are having fun being scoutmasters! I bet you it’s gonna be way more fun when the real term starts!
translation: 哈哈！看来你们当童军团长当得很开心！等正式营期开始，肯定会更有意思！

source: I’m excited.
translation: 我很期待。

source: I’m really looking forward to you all dominating me…
translation: 我真的很期待你们大家支配我……

source: …with orders of course.
translation: ……当然，是用命令。

source: That’s more Gramps’ style! And trust me, he can get real rough!
translation: 那更像Gramps的风格！相信我，他可以很严厉！

source: Speaking of Sir Goro… When are he and Yoshi going to be back?
translation: 说到 Goro 团长……他和 Yoshi 什么时候回来？

source: No one’s stopping you~
translation: 没人拦着你呀～

source: I know right? It’s a really nice vacation do-over for them!
translation: 对吧？这对他们来说是一次很棒的度假补偿！

source: They’d been so excited for this since their wedding. It’s so adorable to see those two so madly in love.
translation: 自从婚礼后，他们就一直很期待这件事。看到他们两个如此热恋，真可爱。

source: Maybe it’s adorable to YOU.
translation: 也许只有你觉得可爱。

source: If that’s the case, then pack your bags, Yuri! We’re going to see that new ‘JS’ movie!
translation: 既然这样，收拾行李吧，Yuri！我们要去看那部新的“JS”电影！

source: Alright now that the girls are gone, circlejerk anyone?!
translation: 好了，既然女孩们走了，有人要一起打手枪吗？！

source: Pass. I’ll go for the hotdogs.
translation: 免了。我去吃热狗。

source: And I’ll go for your buns.
translation: 而我会去吃你的面包。

source: Ahh… It’s good to be back…
translation: 啊……回来真好……

source: But I have to say, that honeymoon trip is the most fun I’ve ever had.
translation: 但我得说，那次蜜月旅行是我经历过最开心的事。

source: I’m glad you enjoyed it, Yoshinori. I was hoping we’d be able to go somewhere special once everything settled down.
translation: 我很高兴你喜欢，Yoshinori。等一切安定下来后，我一直希望我们能去个特别的地方。

source: And today marks exactly six months since we started dating, five months and 26 days since our engagement... and a month since our wedding.
translation: 而今天正好是我们开始交往六个月、订婚五个月零二十六天……也是结婚一个月。

source: You kept count of all that?!
translation: 你连这些都记着？！

source: Aww that’s really sweet, Goro…!
translation: 啊，这真的好甜蜜，Goro……！

source: *clears thoat* But now that we’ve had our fun, it’s time for us to get back to work.
translation: *清嗓* 不过现在我们玩够了，是时候回去工作了。

source: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when they do. All the new buildings and the fun new activities we’ve prepared.
translation: 我迫不及待想看到他们看到那些时的表情。所有新建筑，还有我们准备的有趣新活动。

source: Me too, Goro!
translation: 我也是，Goro！

source: Let’s go in, then? I’m sure everybody’s waiting for us inside.
translation: 那我们进去吧？我相信大家都在里面等着我们。

source: Speaking of Sir Goro… where are he and Yoshi?! I haven’t seen them today.
translation: 说到 Goro 团长……他和 Yoshi 在哪儿？！我今天没见到他们。

source: Wait, don’t you guys know? Today’s their honeymoon!
translation: 等等，你们不知道吗？今天是他们的蜜月！

source: Oh yeaaaahhh... I almost forgot about that. Mr. Clermont got them some special tickets to an island resort, right?!
translation: 哦对——啊……我差点忘了。Clermont 先生给了他们一些去岛屿度假村的特别票，对吧？！

source: Lucky.
translation: 真幸运。

source: Uh-uh, no thank you!
translation: 不了不了，敬谢不敏！

source: Going out would be the best thing to do with so much free time.
translation: 有这么多空闲时间，出去玩会是最好的选择。

source: Whew! That was such a nice swim!
translation: 呼！这次游泳真舒服！

source: Yeah, this place is amazing. Our room even has a balcony overlooking the entire island…
translation: 是啊，这地方太棒了。我们的房间甚至有一个俯瞰整座岛屿的阳台……

source: Oh, I wanna check that out!
translation: 哦，我想去看看！

source: Why don’t we sit there then while we’re drying off?
translation: 那我们擦干身体时，为什么不坐在那里呢？

source: Ahhh… This is the life…
translation: 啊啊……这才是生活……

source: Just being here with you, bathing in the sun, with a cold drink in our hands… It feels like we’re in paradise.
translation: 就这样和你在这里沐浴阳光，手里拿着冰饮……感觉我们身处天堂。

source: Yeah… I’ve never been so spoiled in my life… I almost feel guilty about it.
translation: 是啊……我这辈子从没被这样宠过……几乎都觉得有些愧疚。

source: Well, don’t. We earned this trip. And the only things I really had to spend money on were the upgrades and extra amenities.
translation: 别这么想。我们应得这趟旅行。而我真正花钱的只有升级服务和额外设施。

source: I guess if you put it that way…
translation: 如果你这么说的话……

source: But don’t get me wrong…! I’m really having fun today!
translation: 但别误会……！我今天真的玩得很开心！

source: For once, I can really enjoy my time with you without any work or distractions, knowing that we finished our project!
translation: 难得我们完成了项目，我能真正享受和你在一起的时光，没有工作或其他事情打扰！

source: I’m glad you’re enjoying this, Yoshinori. I’ve been really looking forward to going somewhere special like this once everything settled down.
translation: 我很高兴你喜欢这次旅行，Yoshinori。等一切安定下来后，我一直很期待能去这样一个特别的地方。

source: Well, you have been taking me out on a lot of road trips ever since we got engaged!
translation: 嗯，自从我们订婚后，你就带我去了好多次公路旅行！

source: I can’t help it. I just love spending time with you that much.
translation: 我控制不住。我就是这么喜欢和你共度时光。

source: And to be honest, this trip is extra special.
translation: 而且说实话，这趟旅行格外特别。

source: Oh? What for?
translation: 哦？为什么？

source: Today marks exactly six months since we started dating, five months and 26 days since our engagement... and a month since our wedding.
translation: 而今天正好是我们开始交往六个月、订婚五个月零二十六天……也是结婚一个月。

source: And to celebrate that… I got something for you…
translation: 为了庆祝这个……我给你准备了件东西……

source: Wahh…! A necklace…?!
translation: 哇啊……！一条项链……？！

source: Ah… It suits you perfectly…
translation: 啊……它和你太相配了……

source: Th-This looks crazy expensive…!! You didn’t have to.
translation: 这、这看起来贵得离谱……！！你不必这样的。

source: Well, since this trip was paid for, I had to use my honeymoon budget somewhere, right?
translation: 嗯，既然这趟旅行已经付过钱了，我总得把蜜月预算花在别处，对吧？

source: Besides, you’re more than worth it…
translation: 而且，你绝对值得……

source: Goro… you’re way too romantic…
translation: Goro……你也太浪漫了……

source: Well, do you like it?
translation: 那么，你喜欢吗？

source: I do! I love it! Thank you!
translation: 喜欢！我太喜欢了！谢谢你！

source: *kisses Goro*
translation: *亲吻 Goro*

source: That makes me happy…
translation: 这让我很开心……

source: Now I feel bad I didn’t get anything for you…
translation: 现在我很不好意思，我没给你准备任何东西……

source: You don’t have to. I’m more than happy to be here with you…
translation: 你不必这样。我能和你在这里，就已经非常开心了……

source: At least let me make up for it…!
translation: 至少让我补偿你……！

source: Well…
I’d really love to see you in… nothing but that necklace…
translation: 我真的很想看到你只戴着……那条项链的样子……

source: O-Of course…
translation: 当、当然……

source: Hehe… You’re already hard too…?
translation: 嘿嘿……你也已经硬了……？

source: I can’t help it… I’ve been thinking about doing it with you all day…
translation: 我控制不住……我一整天都在想着和你做……

source: Me too…
translation: 我也是……

source: Ahh… This was the perfect day, Goro…
translation: 啊……今天真是完美的一天，Goro……

source: We got to swim and fool around all day… and to top it all off, now we get to cuddle while watching the sunset…
translation: 我们一整天都能游泳、胡闹……最棒的是，现在还能一边看日落一边拥抱……

source: It really was a great day, wasn’t it Yoshinori?
translation: 确实是很棒的一天，不是吗，Yoshinori？

source: But to be honest, I lost count of how many rounds we did this time.
translation: 但说实话，这次我们做了多少轮，我已经数不清了。

source: I was getting worried you’d be sore from all that beating.
translation: 我有点担心你被狠狠干了那么久会疼。

source: I-I’m used to it… And I love it when you’re rough on me…
translation: 我、我已经习惯了……而且我喜欢你粗暴地对待我……

source: Hehe~ Sounds to me like you haven’t gotten enough even after all that.
translation: 嘿嘿～听起来即使那样之后，你还是没满足。

source: W-Well… I guess I could use a bit of a break to just chill here with you.
translation: 嗯、嗯……我想我可以稍微休息一下，就和你在这里放松。

source: Yeah… I’d like that too.
translation: 是啊……我也想这样。

source: Thank goodness I realized I really was content with the camp…
translation: 幸好我意识到，我其实真的很满足于营地……

source: And that I had the courage to propose to you…
translation: 也幸好我有勇气向你求婚……

source: Yeah… If it weren’t for that, we wouldn’t be together…
translation: 是啊……如果不是那样，我们就不会在一起……

source: To think that we’ve only just begun this chapter… I can’t wait for what else we’ll do out there.
translation: 想想我们才刚刚开始这一篇章……我迫不及待想知道今后还会一起做什么。

source: My future is bright as long as you’re in it…
translation: 只要未来里有你，我的未来就是光明的……

source: I love you, Yoshinori…
translation: 我爱你，Yoshinori……
